intentEvidence: It is intended for users who want notes to remain self-contained, available offline, and less dependent on third-party image hosts.
motivation: It is intended for users who want notes to remain self-contained, available offline, and less dependent on third-party image hosts.
problem: Notes relying on remote image hosts are vulnerable to link rot, requiring manual maintenance to keep content accessible offline.
summary: Downloads remote images found in a note, saves them locally in the vault, and updates the note to use local file paths.
